errors.evidence: The description states that the historical minimums are around 210-230 ppm, but the chart shows that the lowest points are all around 230 ppm and never drop near 210 ppm.

errors.text_span: спад до около 240 ppm преди 100 000 години
errors.evidence: The description states the CO2 level at 100,000 years ago was about 240 ppm, but the data point on the chart for that time is visibly lower, at approximately 230 ppm.
The description omits the value of the data point at year 0 (1950), which is approximately 280 ppm. This point is significant as it marks the beginning of the sharp modern increase.
